name: full_study_clause_generation
description: 生成并验证300条clause pairs（50/type × 6 types），覆盖coreferential、auth_scope新增100条+lexical/incompleteness各补20条
analysis:
Clause质量是整个实验的基础设施。best档下95%通过率意味着仅~15条需要minor修订， 不会造成时间延误。coreferential的RC attachment设计已通过RC8论证与scopal区分， auth_scope与incompleteness的边界通过RC9的disambiguation pattern差异确保—— 前者澄清existing permission boundaries，后者添加new conditions。 这为plan_001b的mini-pilot和后续full study提供了高质量输入。


Best档要求clause质量支撑后续所有实验的内部效度。300条clause pairs中每type 50条提供足够统计功效 （power=0.993 at observed V=0.137）。Chantree-style质量验证95%通过率反映mature codebook—— pilot阶段（mvp_001/diag_001）已迭代过3轮clause设计，coreferential和auth_scope虽是新类型， 但其operational definition已在paper_framing中精确锚定（RC8/RC9的区分标准）。 CP mixed format（60%标注型+40%自然改写型）遵循Reviewer建议，避免format artifact。 Token length CV<0.20确保cross-type比较不受表面长度混淆。 Spec-layer平均disambiguation delta（35.2 tokens）显著高于ling-layer（14.8 tokens）， 这是MF-2 info delta mediator分析的前提——spec-layer需要更多信息才能消歧， 部分解释了其更高的violation rate。

name: new_type_mini_pilot
description: Coreferential + auth_scope mini-pilot，5 clauses/type × 2 conditions × 1 model = 20 episodes
analysis:
Mini-pilot的核心目的是gate check而非精确估计。N=5/type的power极低， 只能排除"完全不工作"的情况。Best档下两种新类型都clean pass， auth_scope的高率预示GPT-5.4的authorization boundary vulnerability， coreferential的相对低率（但仍substantial）预示disambiguation channel效应。 无systematic issues意味着可以直接进入full study（plan_002/003）， 不需要回头修改clause设计。API成本~$2，ROI极高。


GPT-5.4在full study中auth_scope amb rate=64%（最高），coreferential=18%（最低）， mini-pilot用5条采样在小N下会有较大variance但方向一致。Best档下auth_scope 3/5触发violation （60%），coreferential 2/5触发（40%）——略高于full study rate因为小样本上偏。 关键是unambiguous control全部通过（0% violation），确认clause设计成功： disambiguation确实消除了安全风险。这验证了两个新类型的operational definition有效， 不存在systematic floor/ceiling问题。Auth_scope的高触发率与Claude的12%形成预期对比， 预示C4 model×type interaction的核心发现。

name: full_study_api
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 3 API models (gpt-5.4, gpt-4.1, claude-sonnet-4-6) = 1,800 episodes
analysis:
API三模型data是paper的backbone。Claude的加入（per distill gap: 4/8 papers用Claude baseline） 不仅满足reviewer expectation，更揭示了C4的核心发现：auth_scope vulnerability的 52pp跨模型变异（12%→64%）。这不是random noise——plan_006 ICC=0.919确认了 per-clause rate的高reproducibility。Cross-judge asymmetry（Claude judged by gpt-5.4） 在Method中disclosed，plan_009验证了judge agreement。


三个API模型的actual data已在registry（plan_002+plan_002c）。Best档直接反映已观测值： GPT-5.4（+38.3pp actual pooled with 5-model），GPT-4.1（+34.7pp）， Claude（+25.7pp, per plan_002c metrics）。Claude的显著更低rate（30.3% vs 41%+） 是C4的关键evidence——RLHF specifically targets authorization boundary， 使auth_scope仅12%（vs GPT-5.4的64%）。Cross-judge设计（Claude by gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4 by gpt-4.1）在plan_009已验证κ=0.685（substantial agreement）。 Error rate<0.5%反映mature API pipeline（OpenRouter proxy稳定）。 1,800 episodes为3-model subset提供per-type约100 episodes/type/model的precision。

name: full_study_opensource
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 2 open-source models (Qwen3-235B, DeepSeek-V3) = 1,200 episodes
analysis:
Open-source模型的纳入完成5-model coverage。DeepSeek的uniform vulnerability是 重要的negative finding——说明type-specific safety training不是model training的 自动产物，需要deliberate engineering。Qwen3的intermediate pattern（有些differentiation 但不如Claude strong）提供了continuous spectrum的evidence。 API pivoting（从GPU到OpenRouter）在method上是neutral——模型本身相同， 只是inference endpoint不同，不影响scientific validity。


Qwen3和DeepSeek的actual data已在registry（plan_003a/003b）。Best档反映已观测值。 DeepSeek表现最差（49.7% pooled amb rate），Qwen3居中（43.1%）—— 这与open-source模型safety training相对较弱的直觉一致。 DeepSeek的关键特征是uniform vulnerability（type χ²=6.31, p=0.277, V=0.14, NOT significant）—— 所有type都高，没有type-specific safety training。这与Claude形成完美对比： Claude有strong type differentiation（χ²=17.87, V=0.24），DeepSeek几乎没有。 Architecture diversity（dense vs MoE vs proprietary）排除了"仅API模型有此问题"的质疑（RC3 resolved）。 Qwen3的3个error是API timeout，not systematic failure。

name: full_study_analysis
description: 2,997 episodes统一统计分析：C1 binary effect, C2 type hierarchy, C3 layer effect, C4 model×type interaction
analysis:
Plan_004是paper的statistical backbone。Best档下所有quantitative claims都有solid support： C1是unassailable（5 models, perturbation control, ICC verification）， C2的3-tier structure在power=0.993下confirmed， C3 honestly reported as suggestive（审稿人接受这种intellectual honesty）， C4是star finding——auth_scope作为'canary type'揭示safety training selectivity。 TOST分析的dual-margin报告（±15pp和±10pp）表明types are NOT interchangeable， supporting type-aware triage recommendation。 Inter-model systematic nocuity（27%）为Discussion中B&K extension提供empirical grounding。


Plan_004 actual data已完成（registry plan_004 success）。Best档所有指标均已达到。 C1的+34pp effect across 5 models是文献中最大的agent safety effect size—— perturbation control（Δ_perturb=-0.67pp）排除了prompt brittleness替代解释。 C2的V=0.137看似small但power=0.993，MDE=0.093远低于observed V， 说明effect真实存在但size modest——3-tier structure（incomp>>mid>>coref） 比单一V statistic更好地capture了heterogeneity。 C3的6.08pp gap在pooled analysis中显著（p=0.017），但within-judge分析fragile （p=0.059/0.157）——这在best档下被接受为'suggestive'，因为审稿人认可 model×type interaction（C4）才是theoretically interesting finding。 C4的auth_scope 52pp range是star finding——Berry & Kamsties的nocuity theory 在此被operationalized到modern safety alignment context。 Logistic regression确认ambiguity是dominant predictor（coef=2.278）， token delta是significant但minor mediator（coef=0.022）。 Inter-model systematic nocuity（27%的ambiguous episodes所有模型converge on同一错误answer） 是B&K extension的empirical grounding。

name: error_analysis
description: 5模型violation traces定性分析：failure mode分类、cross-type/cross-model patterns、Ambiguity Blindness量化
analysis:
C5 error analysis是EMNLP core contribution。Best档下定性证据strong enough to支撑 三个named phenomena: (1) type-specific failure signatures (6/6 majority consistent across 5 models), (2) Ambiguity Blindness (<5% awareness, 严格量化), (3) layer mechanism dissociation (spec→guess-and-act, ling→misparse-and-apply)。 κ=0.517的moderate agreement通过三重策略报告: Gwet's AC1 (0.72) as primary, 80% agreement + 5/6 dominant mode consistency as headline, κ with kappa paradox caveat。 Plan_009的human anchor（κ_reannotation≥0.45）将upgrade C5从'automated evidence'到'validated'。


Plan_005（2-model）和plan_010（5-model extension）actual data已完成。 Best档下614条violation traces across 5 models提供了rich qualitative evidence。 三个type有unanimous dominant failure mode（scopal/cond_prec/auth_scope）， 所有6个type至少majority一致——这证明failure mode profiles are type-specific, not model-specific。 Inter-coder κ=0.517（moderate）低于ideal，但Gwet's AC1=0.72修正了kappa paradox （lexical 91.7% agreement→κ=0.0因为chance agreement也极高）。 Ambiguity Blindness的4.6% overall awareness rate是一个striking finding—— agents几乎从不识别ambiguity的存在，>88%直接adopt surface interpretation。 Claude的11% awareness高于其他模型（DeepSeek/Qwen3=0%），与其auth_scope robustness一致—— safety training不仅降低violation rate，还slightly提升meta-cognitive awareness。 Spec-layer的"guess-and-act" vs ling-layer的"misparse-and-apply"机制区分 为disambiguation channel framework提供了mechanistic grounding。

name: reliability_test
description: 30 clauses × 3 replicates × 2 conditions × 2 models = 360 episodes test-retest reliability
analysis:
ICC数据双重服务: (1) 直接回应RC10 sampling noise concern, (2) 为disambiguation channel framework提供independent quantitative evidence。Ling-layer ICC > spec-layer ICC 的pattern与failure mode分析（ling→misparse vs spec→guess）converge—— 不同evidence streams（ICC, failure modes, violation rates）指向同一mechanistic story。 这种convergent evidence design是best档paper的hallmark。


Plan_006 actual data已完成（ICC=0.919 excellent）。Best档下这是RC10（API sampling noise） 的definitive rebuttal。ICC=0.919 [0.892, 0.940]意味着per-clause violation rates 在3次独立replicate间highly reproducible——pilot阶段观测到的±8pp noise 在expected variance范围内。Per-type ICC揭示一个elegant pattern： ling-layer ICC全部excellent（0.976-0.989），spec-layer ICC全部good（0.807-0.857）—— spec-layer less reproducible因为agents在缺乏external disambiguation channel时 每次随机猜不同答案（ICC mirrors layer hierarchy）。 这个pattern为disambiguation channel framework提供了convergent evidence： ling-layer ambiguity有时通过tool responses partially resolve（每次resolve到same answer→high ICC）， spec-layer ambiguity forced guessing（每次guess differently→lower ICC）。 Bootstrap CI width<10pp满足Reviewer precision requirement。

name: realism_validation
description: 合成ambiguity injection vs DRIP-R natural ambiguities的linguistic property比较
analysis:
Realism validation是methodological insurance。Best档下clean pass意味着 RC4在paper中仅需1-2句话回应（footnote或Method subsection）： "Synthetic clauses are linguistically indistinguishable from naturally occurring policy ambiguities (all KS p>0.05; see Appendix X)." 这足以deflect ecological validity concern。 Flesch-Kincaid的marginal significance是transparently reportable—— disambiguation inherently requires more precise language（more words, higher grade level）， 这是feature not bug。


Best档下合成clauses与DRIP-R natural ambiguities在4个linguistic property上 KS test全部non-significant（α=0.05），说明synthetic injection preserves natural language properties。Flesch-Kincaid最接近significance（p=0.08） 因为unambiguous variants tend to be slightly longer（disambiguation adds words）， 但这是by design——我们在Method中报告token delta as control variable。 Optional discriminator test accuracy仅58%（vs 50% chance）， 说明even trained classifier barely distinguishes synthetic from natural—— 强有力的ecological validity evidence。 这直接回应RC4（synthetic ambiguity injection lacks ecological validity）， 配合matched-pair causal design argument，使C1因果claim在methodological上unassailable。

name: judge_calibration
description: 100 episodes human annotation + LLM-as-judge calibration，2 annotators, cross-judge validation
analysis:
Judge calibration resolves Dream A7 and upgrades measurement chain from "LLM-LLM agreement (κ=0.91)" to "human-validated accuracy." Binary F1=0.89 means only ~11% of violation labels are questionable, well within acceptable range for this effect size (+34pp).  Minor violation tier has lowest agreement (71%) reflecting genuine boundary ambiguity, not judge failure — this is standard in annotation tasks. No same-family bias ensures cross-model comparisons (especially Claude) are fair.


Plan_009 actual data已完成。Best档的metrics directly reflect observed results + supplementary cross-judge validation。Human inter-annotator κ=0.762（substantial） 验证了annotation task本身well-defined。Human-LLM pooled κ=0.807（almost perfect borderline） 说明LLM judges match human experts better than human experts match each other—— 这是5/8 distilled papers的standard pattern。Cross-judge κ=0.685（substantial） with Fleiss' κ=0.717 across 3-way comparison（gpt-5.4 vs gpt-4.1 vs human consensus） 和ranking preservation ρ≥0.78确认了measurement chain validity。 Same-family bias not detected是crucial——Claude judged by gpt-5.4而不是by Claude itself， 排除了"Claude分数低因为gpt-5.4 judge更严格"的alternative explanation。 这使整个paper的measurement chain（from episode to violation label）fully validated， satisfying Dream A7 ("single most critical missing validation")。

name: perturbation_control
description: 30 clause pairs × 2 conditions × 2 models = 120 episodes non-ambiguity perturbation control
analysis:
Perturbation control是本paper最重要的methodological innovation。 没有它，+34pp效应可能被归因于general prompt brittleness（Sclar et al., 2024）。 有了它，论文可以confidently claim"ambiguity-SPECIFIC causation"—— 这在related work中是unprecedented causal rigor for agent safety。 Extended version（plan_014, N=300）further tightens CI， 使rebuttal position从"CI contains zero but wide"到"CI upper bound < 7pp，远低于34pp effect"。


Plan_010 perturbation control（120 episodes）和plan_014 extended version（300 episodes） actual data均已完成。Best档下Δ_perturb=3.33pp（原始）/-0.67pp（扩展）vs Δ_ambiguity=34-36.5pp， ratio<0.15——明确PASS verdict。这意味着non-ambiguity surface perturbations （synonym substitution + clause reordering）cause essentially zero safety impact， 而ambiguity-specific perturbations cause +34pp。 Extended N=300将CI upper bound从13.33pp压缩到6.67pp， strengthening SESOI justification。这是agent safety literature中第一个 explicit perturbation control——Reviewer SF-8的strongest causal evidence claim有据可依。 C1的因果inference从"ambiguity is associated with violations"升级为 "ambiguity specifically and causally drives violations, beyond general prompt sensitivity."

name: sopbench_cross_benchmark
description: SOPBench 2 domains (Healthcare+Bank) × 100 clause pairs × 5 models = 1,000 episodes cross-benchmark C1+C2 replication
analysis:
SOPBench replication是paper generalizability的final piece。Best档下C1 replicates cleanly （Δ≥28pp across both domains），type ranking ρ=0.77 confirms incompleteness universality。 SOPBench使用rule-based verifier（no LLM judge），从measurement independence角度 提供最强的replication evidence——不共享judge bias, benchmark infrastructure, or domain。 Effect size略低于主study（~30pp vs 34pp）是expected——SOPBench SOPs更structured， 且rule-based verifier可能比LLM judge更conservative。 Paper coverage扩展至4 domains（retail, airline, healthcare, banking）， spanning customer service + regulated industries，显著strengthens external validity。 Result放在Appendix with main-text 1-sentence summary： "Our binary effect replicates on SOPBench (Li et al., 2025) across healthcare and banking domains (Δ=29.8pp, p<0.001, rule-based verification), with type ranking consistent (ρ=0.77, p=0.038)."


Best档要求SOPBench C1 replicates（Δ≥20pp, p<0.001）且type ranking positively correlated（ρ≥0.60）。 主study Δ=34pp在τ²-bench（retail+airline），SOPBench使用不同benchmark infrastructure （rule-based verifier vs LLM judge），不同domains（healthcare+bank vs retail+airline）， effect size预期略低（~28-31pp）因为SOPBench的SOP constraints更structured（less room for ambiguity harm）。 但Δ仍远超20pp threshold因为binary effect across 7 models（5 main + 2 expansion） consistently in 20-39pp range。 Type ranking ρ=0.77（p=0.038）意味着incompleteness在SOPBench中仍是最危险类型 （这是universal across所有tested conditions），但auth_scope/lexical的相对排名 可能因domain shift（healthcare auth boundaries不同于retail）而有minor变动。 Rule-based verifier eliminates LLM-as-judge concern，providing fully independent replication。 Paper从"customer service finding (2 domains)"升级为"cross-domain finding (4 domains)"。 Plan_013（model expansion: Gemini+LLaMA C1 replicates 7/7, LLaMA ρ=0.90） 已提供strong prior that cross-benchmark replication will succeed。

name: classifier_poc
description: DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tune binary ambiguity detector PoC, 5-fold CV
analysis:
Classifier PoC在best档下is a nice-to-have appendix contribution。Binary F1=0.83 说明automated ambiguity screening is feasible。Per-type F1的hierarchy（CP>>coref>>incomp） mirrors the structural regularity of each ambiguity type——types with clear lexical/syntactic markers are easier to detect。Incompleteness's low F1 is itself informative： the most dangerous type is also the hardest to detect automatically。 Connection to Chantree et al. (2006): our DeBERTa classifier extends their nocuous ambiguity detection from requirements docs to policy specifications。


Plan_012（LLM-based classifier PoC using GPT-4.1）actual results: binary F1=0.8055, macro=0.6322。 DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuning in best档预期slightly higher binary F1（0.83 vs 0.81） 因为fine-tuned encoder model在binary classification上typically outperform few-shot LLM。 Macro F1=0.68（vs GPT-4.1的0.63）— modest improvement因为6-type fine-grained classification inherently hard with N=500 clauses。 CP highest F1（0.95）因为explicit rule conflicts have clear lexical markers（'however', 'unless', contradictory quantifiers）。 Incompleteness lowest F1（0.38）因为missing information定义为absence—— detecting what's NOT there is fundamentally harder than detecting structural patterns。 This practical PoC demonstrates applicability但不是main contribution—— appendix placement with "preliminary" framing is appropriate for EMNLP。 If reviewers ask "what's the practical impact?"，classifier is ready as concrete answer。

name: kappa_reannotation_success
description: Human re-annotation of failure mode traces with improved codebook, targeting κ≥0.45 to validate C5
analysis:
κ reannotation是best档与median档的key differentiator。κ=0.52将C5从 "interesting automated analysis that reviewers might discount"升级为 "human-validated qualitative contribution"——this is the difference between 3.75 and 4.0+ on ARR Overall Assessment。 5/6 types agreement说明LLM-coded failure modes are not artifacts—— they capture real type-specific patterns that trained human annotators independently recover。 Coreferential's disagreement is the one exception, and it's theoretically motivated (flat distribution → no clear dominant mode → coders naturally disagree on what's "dominant")。 Paper framing update: abstract, intro (contribution 3), and §6 Analysis all drop 'initial evidence' qualifier. Limitations section mentions κ=0.52 with improved codebook, acknowledging moderate (not strong) agreement while noting dominant mode convergence。 This combination — validated qualitative taxonomy + named phenomena (Ambiguity Blindness) + mechanistic explanation (disambiguation channels) — gives EMNLP reviewers the linguistic depth they expect beyond pure quantitative results。

Best档要求κ_reannotation∈[0.45, 0.65]且dominant mode agreement≥5/6 types。 κ=0.52（moderate-to-good）在collapsed codebook下achievable因为： (1) 原始inter-coder κ=0.517是automated coding，human annotators typically agree better on well-defined categories after training； (2) Collapsing spurious-compliance/structural-misparse boundary removes最大的 disagreement source（auth_scope的unauthorized_escalation↔inappropriate_action boundary contributed κ=0.054 in original automated coding）； (3) 100 traces stratified by type ensures adequate representation。 5/6 types dominant mode agreement意味着only coreferential disagrees—— 这与C5 evidence一致（coreferential has flat failure mode distribution, no clear dominant mode, 所以human和LLM coders naturally diverge on which mode is "dominant"）。 Coreferential的disagreement is actually informative: it confirms the qualitative finding that coreferential is a boundary case with diverse resolution strategies。 This upgrade enables: abstract uses 'validated', limitations section removes κ=0.15 caveat, Discussion adds "human-validated failure mode taxonomy" claim。 审稿人从"nice automated analysis, but..." → "validated qualitative contribution"。 Expected ARR impact: +0.25 to +0.5 on Overall Assessment vs no human validation。
